items.title: Amin Adam questions Ato Forson over transparency of bond buyback offer
items.summary: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson is facing questions over the government's voluntary Domestic Debt Exchange Programme (DDEP) bond buyback, with his predecessor, Dr Mohammed Amin Adam, urging him to uphold the standards he championed while in opposition. items.title: COP31: Four reasons the Antalya climate summit fell short of expectations
